changed_msgids: Ear Tag is a simple audio file tag editor. It is primarily geared towards making quick edits or bulk-editing tracks in albums/EPs. Unlike other tagging programs, Ear Tag does not require the user to set up a music library folder. It can:
No supported files found in opened folder
Maximum folder depth reached, some files may not be loaded
Some of the opened files have invalid values; cannot save
When opening a folder, include files from its subfolders
Some files could not be renamed.
If you don't save your changes, they will be permanently lost.
Could not save file {f}. Check the logs for more information.
Ear Tag needs additional permissions to rename files in-place.
Failed to rename files. Check the logs for more information.
For a list of available placeholders, see the list of available tags.
Automatically ignores ID suffixes often found in filenames of downloaded files. Disable this option if it interferes with your filenames.
Track information is provided by Musicbrainz. Files without metadata are identified using the AcoustID service.
Search for the track on MusicBrainz, then paste the MusicBrainz ID or a link to the MusicBrainz recording page here.
Minimum confidence percentage required for a MusicBrainz search result to be evaluated
Minimum confidence percentage required for an AcoustID lookup result to be evaluated
